final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.ID, g.c, g.c*1.0/t.tot AS sh FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.c) AS avg_count, AVG(s.sh) AS avg_share, AVG(s.sh - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.sh > a.av
